column5: THE BOARD IS BUILT; THE PAGE, THE PAYTABLE ROW AND THE HISTORY COLUMN ARE NOT. (1) No /play/darts route exists, so the 1440x3294 detail page 9392-1798 - mis-titled 'Hi-Lo Start' in Figma, its own header text reads 'Darts' - and the 375x812 page 9442-17258 (mis-titled 'Blackjack') are unbuilt; Darts is a modal off /originals only. (2) THE FRAME'S MULTIPLIER LEGEND DOES NOT EXIST IN CODE. Every desktop frame draws a 6-chip row beneath the board, each chip underlined in its ring colour - Easy 9411-7933 reads 0.5x 0.8x 1.2x 1.5x 2.7x 8.5x - and DartsGame.tsx renders no such row. Its RINGS_MAP (line 105) is 7 entries [0, 0.2, 0.3, 0.65, 1.55, 3, 8] including a 0x Miss, ONE shared table across all three difficulties, so not one of the six Easy values appears anywhere in the code, and Figma's Hard table (topping 500x) is 62.5x away from the implemented 8x. The equivalent information lives in a Score Chart Dialog instead of the frame's inline row. (3) The in-play frame 9433-16420 carries a right-hand VERTICAL throw-history column of colour-bordered result chips; DartsGame renders no per-throw history anywhere. (4) Figma labels the middle difficulty 'Medium' where the code's Difficulty type (line 88) is 'normal', and the code exposes it as a dropdown rather than the frame's segmented control. (5) Mobile Medium 9455-19001 and Mobile Hard 9467-19582 have no mobile layout. 0 of 8 frames have ever been visually verified. ★ CLIENT AND BACKEND DO AGREE on the table that IS implemented (aligned by a 2026-07-16 fix: rings [0, 0.2, 0.3, 0.65, 1.55, 3, 8] with weights easy [36,6,10,19,16,10,3] / normal [49,7,8,11,11,9,5] / hard [57,7,4,8,10,8,6] at ~95% RTP, difficulty being variance-only), so the open decision is whether the frames get re-cut to the shipped table or the rail is repriced to the frames - not a code-vs-code drift. Per the Chicken precedent the frames were re-cut to the rail, but Chicken has since been rebuilt TO Figma, so that precedent no longer settles it. NOTE the Figma Medium and Hard frames each carry a second group of six values identical to Easy (0.5x 8.5x 1.5x 0.8x 1.2x 2.7x), which looks like an un-updated duplicate and should be confirmed with the designer before either side moves.
